sources.title: Anthropic and Amazon expand collaboration for up to 5 gigawatts of new compute

event.title: Anthropic and Amazon compute agreement and investment
event.summary: Anthropic signed a new agreement with Amazon for up to 5 gigawatts of capacity and committed to spend on AWS technologies over ten years. Amazon invested in Anthropic on the same day, with more possible later.

amounts.label: Compute commitment to AWS
amounts.quote: We are committing more than $100 billion over the next ten years to AWS technologies, securing up to 5GW of new capacity to train and run Claude.

amounts.label: Amazon investment
amounts.quote: Amazon is investing $5 billion in Anthropic today, with up to an additional $20 billion in the future.

amounts.label: Possible future Amazon investment
amounts.condition: In the future; no date or terms stated
amounts.quote: Amazon is investing $5 billion in Anthropic today, with up to an additional $20 billion in the future.

amounts.label: Amazon's earlier investments
amounts.quote: This builds on the $8 billion Amazon has previously invested.

quantities.label: Capacity
quantities.quote: secure up to 5 gigawatts (GW) of capacity for training and deploying Claude

facts.label: Chips
facts.text: Graviton and Trainium2 through Trainium4, with an option on later Amazon chips.
facts.quote: The commitment spans Graviton and Trainium2 through Trainium4 chips, with the option to purchase future generations of Amazon's custom silicon as they become available.

facts.label: Timing
facts.text: Nearly 1 GW of Trainium2 and Trainium3 capacity online by the end of 2026.
facts.quote: nearly 1GW total of Trainium2 and Trainium3 capacity coming online by the end of 2026

relations.note: The $5 billion investment is counted in the Series H round.
